title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 36 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 36)

content.overview: Section 36 provides for enforcement of an arbitral award as if it were a decree of the Court once the statutory setting-aside period has expired or the application under section 34 has been refused, subject to the statutory provisions governing stay of enforcement.
content.glance: Section 36 provides for enforcement of an arbitral award as if it were a decree of the Court once the statutory setting-aside period has expired or the application under section 34 has been refused, subject to the statutory provisions governing stay of enforcement.
